# Telegram Messenger

> Telegram is a cloud-based messaging platform focused on fast, secure communication, public channels, bots, mini apps, and developer APIs.

Telegram provides consumer messaging apps, public channel publishing, bot and mini app platforms, open-source clients, and technical documentation for building on the Telegram ecosystem.

## Core Product

- [Telegram Messenger](https://t.me/): Main product homepage with core features, platform overview, and official entry points.
- [Telegram Web](https://web.telegram.org/): Browser-based Telegram client for messaging without installing a desktop or mobile app.
- [Telegram Apps](https://telegram.org/apps): Official download hub for Telegram apps across mobile, desktop, and web platforms.
- [Telegram FAQ](https://telegram.org/faq): General product FAQ covering accounts, privacy, chats, channels, and platform behavior.
- [Telegram Features](https://telegram.org/features): Overview of major messaging, media, privacy, and community features across Telegram.

## Downloads and Clients

- [Telegram for Android](https://telegram.org/android): Official Android client download and installation information.
- [Telegram for iPhone and iPad](https://telegram.org/dl/ios): Official iOS app download page for Apple devices.
- [Telegram Desktop](https://desktop.telegram.org/): Official desktop client for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- [Telegram for macOS](https://macos.telegram.org/): Native macOS Telegram client download and release information.
- [Telegram Web A](https://web.telegram.org/a/): Modern web client optimized for full-featured browser messaging.
- [Telegram Web K](https://web.telegram.org/k/): Alternate official web client with broad browser support.

## Developer Platform

- [Telegram API](https://core.telegram.org/api): Core developer documentation for Telegram client APIs and protocol concepts.
- [Bot API](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api): HTTP-based API reference for building Telegram bots and integrations.
- [MTProto Mobile Protocol](https://core.telegram.org/mtproto): Technical specification for Telegram’s mobile messaging protocol.
- [TDLib](https://core.telegram.org/tdlib): Cross-platform client library for building custom Telegram applications.
- [Telegram Database Library API Example](https://core.telegram.org/tdlib/docs/): TDLib documentation and generated API reference for developers.
- [Telegram Login Widget](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login): Documentation for Telegram-based authentication on external websites.
- [Telegram Widgets](https://core.telegram.org/widgets): Embeddable widgets for posts, channels, logins, and sharing actions.
- [Mini Apps](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps): Documentation for Telegram Mini Apps running inside bot-powered web interfaces.

## Bot Development

- [Bots Overview](https://core.telegram.org/bots): Introduction to Telegram bots, capabilities, and platform concepts.
- [Bot API Reference](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api): Complete method and object reference for Telegram Bot API integrations.
- [Bot Payments](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments): Guide to accepting payments through Telegram bots.
- [Games for Bots](https://core.telegram.org/bots/games): Documentation for building HTML5 games integrated with Telegram bots.
- [Inline Bots](https://core.telegram.org/bots/inline): Guide to bots that return results directly inside chats.
- [Bot Commands](https://core.telegram.org/bots#commands): Bot command behavior and interface conventions for chat interactions.

## Mini Apps and Web Integrations

- [Mini Apps Platform](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps): Main documentation for Telegram Mini Apps embedded in chats and menus.
- [Mini Apps Methods](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps): Initialization and JavaScript integration details for Mini Apps.
- [WebApp JavaScript API](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#webappinterface): Browser-side API for interacting with Telegram client features.
- [Main Mini Apps Concepts](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#main-mini-app-concepts): Core concepts for lifecycle, UI behavior, and Telegram integration.
- [Login Widget](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login): Telegram authentication widget for websites and web applications.
- [Sharing Widget](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/share): Share button widget for sending links and content into Telegram chats.

## Security and Privacy

- [Telegram Security Guidelines](https://core.telegram.org/mtproto/security_guidelines): Security guidance for developers implementing Telegram-related software.
- [MTProto Protocol](https://core.telegram.org/mtproto): Cryptographic and transport protocol documentation for Telegram messaging.
- [Telegram FAQ for the Technically Inclined](https://core.telegram.org/techfaq): Technical FAQ covering architecture, encryption, and protocol decisions.
- [Telegram Security Model](https://telegram.org/faq#q-how-does-telegram-encryption-work): High-level explanation of Telegram encryption and chat security.
- [Telegram Privacy Policy](https://telegram.org/privacy): Official privacy policy describing data handling and user protections.
- [Telegram Terms of Service](https://telegram.org/tos): Terms governing use of Telegram apps, services, and platform features.

## Open Source and Community

- [Telegram Apps Source Code](https://telegram.org/apps#source-code): Official links to open-source Telegram client repositories and codebases.
- [Telegram for Android Source](https://github.com/DrKLO/Telegram): Open-source repository for the official Telegram Android client.
- [Telegram Desktop Source](https://github.com/telegramdesktop/tdesktop): Open-source repository for the official Telegram Desktop application.
- [TDLib Source](https://github.com/tdlib/td): Source repository for Telegram Database Library used in custom clients.
- [Translations Platform](https://translations.telegram.org/): Community translation portal for localizing Telegram interfaces and strings.
- [Telegram Design Guidelines](https://core.telegram.org/design): Design resources and interface guidance for Telegram-related development.

## Guides and Support

- [Telegram FAQ](https://telegram.org/faq): Main support resource for common questions about accounts, chats, and settings.
- [Telegram Support](https://telegram.org/support): Official support contact page for reporting issues and requesting help.
- [Ask a Question](https://telegram.org/faq#q-i-have-a-question-about-telegram-apps): FAQ entry point for app-related support questions.
- [Recovering Your Account](https://telegram.org/faq#q-my-phone-was-stolen-what-do-i-do): Guidance for lost devices, account access, and session security.
- [Channels FAQ](https://telegram.org/faq_channels): FAQ focused on channels, public broadcasting, and subscriptions.
- [Bots FAQ](https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq): Frequently asked questions for bot developers and operators.

## Official News and Updates

- [Telegram News](https://t.me/s/telegram): Official Telegram channel with product announcements and feature updates.
- [Telegram Stable Releases](https://t.me/s/tgstable): Official release notes and stable build announcements across Telegram clients.
- [Telegram Tips](https://t.me/s/TelegramTips): Official tips channel highlighting useful features and workflows.
- [Telegram Beta Blog](https://t.me/s/betainfo): Public channel covering beta features and pre-release Telegram changes.

## Platform Entry Points

- [Telegram on X](https://x.com/telegram): Official social account for product updates and public announcements.
- [Telegram on GitHub](https://github.com/telegramdesktop): Public development presence for Telegram Desktop source and issues.
- [Telegram Android on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.telegram.messenger): Official Android app listing on Google Play.
- [Telegram for iOS on App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/telegram-messenger/id686449807): Official iOS app listing on Apple’s App Store.
